title: Microsoft OpenTelemetry Distro overview
description: Learn about the Microsoft OpenTelemetry distribution, a unified observability package for Azure Monitor, Microsoft Agent 365, and OTLP-compatible backends.
summary: Microsoft OpenTelemetry Distro is a unified observability distribution that provides a single onboarding experience for collecting traces, metrics, and logs from agentic and nonagentic applications. It supports observability for Microsoft Agent 365, Microsoft Foundry, Azure Monitor, and any OpenTelemetry Protocol (OTLP)-compatible backend. The distro supports .NET, Node.js, and Python, and replaces fragmented setup across multiple observability stacks with one import and one configuration call.
